question: A thing is an entity that can be identified in the oneM2M System.
label: Simple

question: A thing may have properties
label: Simple

question: A thing can have relations to other things
label: Complex

question: An aspect could be a (physical or non-physical) entity or it could be a quality
label: Simple

question: An aspect can have metadata
label: Simple

question: Metadata contain data (like units, precision-ranges â¦) about a variable or about an aspect
label: Simple

question: A device is a thing that is able to interact electronically with its environment via a network
label: Simple

question: A device may be a physical or non-physical entity
label: Simple

question: A device performs one or more functionalities in order to accomplish a particular task
label: Complex

question: A device has one or more services that expose in the network its functionalities
label: Complex

question: A device can be composed of several (sub-)devices
label: Complex

question: An interworked device is a device that does not support oneM2M interfaces and can only be accessed from the oneM2M System by communicating with a "proxied" (virtual) device that has been created by an interworking proxy entity
label: Complex

question: An interworked device is part of an area network
label: Simple

question: An area network is a network that provides data transport services between an interworked device and the oneM2M System
label: Simple

question: An area network follows an standard that defines its physical properties
label: Simple

question: An area network follows a communication protocol
label: Simple

question: An area network follows a profile
label: Simple

question: A service is an electronic representation of a functionality in a network
label: Simple

question: A service can expose one or more functionalities
label: Complex

question: A service can be composed of independent (sub-)services
label: Complex

question: A service has an operation
label: Simple

question: A service has an input data point
label: Simple

question: A service has an output data point
label: Simple

question: A functionality represents the functionality necessary to accomplish the task for which a device is designed
label: Simple

question: A functionality refers to (e.g. observes or influences) some real-world aspect(s)
label: Simple

question: A functionality has commands that allow human users to influence/observe such functionality
label: Complex

question: A controlling functionality represents a functionality that has impacts on the real world, but does not gather data
label: Simple

question: A measuring functionality represents a functionality that has no impacts on the real world, but only gathers data
label: Simple

question: An operation is the means of a service to communicate in a procedure-type manner over the network (i.e. transmit data to/from other devices)
label: Simple

question: An operation is the -machine interpretable- exposure of a -human understandable- command to a network
label: Complex

question: An operation may receive input data from input data points (persistent entities)
label: Simple

question: An operation may receive data from operation inputs (transient entities that are deleted when the operation finishes)
label: Simple

question: An operation may produce output data into output data points (persistent entities)
label: Simple

question: An operation may produce data into operation outputs (transient entities that are deleted when the operation finishes)
label: Simple

question: An operation has an operation state that allows a oneM2M entity to get informed on the progress of that operation
label: Simple

question: An operation has a method
label: Simple

question: An operation has a target URI
label: Simple

question: A command represents an action that can be performed to support a functionality
label: Simple

question: A command has as input one or more operation inputs
label: Simple

question: A command has as output one or more operation outputs
label: Simple

question: An operation input describes an input of an operation and also describes the input of a command
label: Simple

question: An operation output describes an output of an operation and also describes the output of a command
label: Complex

question: An operation state describes the current state of an operation
label: Simple

question: An operation state is a simple type variable
label: Simple

question: An operation state has exactly one data restriction pattern
label: Simple

question: An input data point is a variable of a service that is accessed by a RESTful device in its environment and that the device reads out autonomously (e.g. at periodic times)
label: Complex

question: An output data point is a variable of a service that is set by a RESTful device in its environment and that the device updates autonomously (e.g. at periodic times)
label: Complex

question: A variable describes an entity that stores some data (e.g. integers, text, etc., or structured data) that can change over time
label: Complex

question: A variable describes a real-world aspect
label: Complex

question: A variable can have metadata
label: Simple

question: A variable can be structured using other variables
label: Complex

question: A variable may have a value (useful for values that are relatively static)
label: Simple

question: A variable has a CRUD method through which the instantiation of the variable value can be manipulated
label: Complex

question: A variable has a URI of a resource through which the instantiation of the value of the variable can be manipulated
label: Complex

question: A simple type variable is a variable that only consists of variables of simple XML types like xsd:integer, xsd:string, etc., potentially including restrictions
label: Simple

question: A simple type variable contains the name of the attribute of the resource that is referenced with the target URI and that stores the value of the simple type variable
label: Simple

question: A simple type variable has exactly one datatype
label: Simple

question: A simple type variable has a data restriction
label: Simple
